honest_verdict: ROC-AUC 0.489 on chronological 2024 holdout -- indistinguishable from random (0.50). Confirmed by 3 independent lines of evidence: near-zero correlations (EDA), negligible effect sizes across 7 hypothesis tests, and this full 5-algorithm model comparison with threshold tuning and SMOTE resampling, none of which improved performance. NOT RECOMMENDED for operational deployment as a shortage early-warning system.
recommended_alternative: Capacity-based safety stock (see Section 8: Inventory Optimization) targeted at facilities with historically elevated shortage rates (Phase 7 facility risk ranking), rather than per-record prediction.
